critique: The warm, high-key bedding palette, feathered close framing, and slow 1.2% video drift give Pickles an intimate, curious presence at believable scale without resorting to enlargement. The generic dust motes, dense foreground straw polygons, paper-grade overlay, and date stamp dilute that direct encounter; reducing them would keep her glossy eyes, wiry facial tufts, pink nose, whiskers, and tiny feet visually decisive.
